plugin.name: a11y-knowledge
plugin.description: Read-only accessibility knowledge for any project, including built-in SPDS, Fluent V8/V9 and SharePoint/ODSP guidance selected only when relevant. One installation; no execution setup.

topics.trigger: Starting a review, selecting standards or reporting uncertainty.
topics.scope: Source-only reasoning and honest findings; no runtime verification.

topics.trigger: Elements, names, roles, states, structure or component relationships change.
topics.scope: Native semantics and the actual project's component contract.

topics.trigger: Keyboard interaction, dialogs, navigation or focus can change.
topics.scope: Keyboard paths and focus lifecycle inferred from available source.

topics.trigger: Inputs, validation, images, icons, tables or media change.
topics.scope: Labels, errors, alternatives and meaningful structure.

topics.trigger: Loading, results, errors, notifications or asynchronous state changes.
topics.scope: Status exposure, feedback ownership and stable focus.

topics.trigger: Styles, themes, contrast, focus indicators, layout, zoom or motion change.
topics.scope: Source-visible risks with explicit rendering uncertainty.
